messages.subject: adversarial D1 a-vs-b: merge-log Status success; pipeline partial (not converged)
messages.body: Ran /sc:adversarial --compare option-a.md,option-b.md --depth quick --output .dev/p0-live/adversarial/ after the brief guard passed (no Unattended mode section in either command copy, no --unattended on the line); merge-log.md Metadata Status is success (8 of 8 changes, validation PASS), so the P0 rule gives succeeded, while the skill's own return contract says partial because the 1-round debate reached 73% agreement against the 80% threshold. Option a won as base (0.772 against 0.660); both papers' SPEC line numbers match specs/history/spec-v4-after-round3.md rather than the spec file their key names, option b's claim that the AC-C1 grep would need an exception is false (SPEC:207 is case-sensitive), and the plan review caught that an advocate's 2026-11-04 'variable set in a non-worker subagent' report was really this worker's own inherited handle, so it was dropped. Left open: 10 unresolved debate points, a minor defect where merged-output.md cites (V2:N) with no key entry, and a gitignored .venv/ (possibly uv.lock) created in the worktree by a reviewer's uv run; nothing was staged or committed.
